candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Same route on Town01 with slight ego spawn shift and slightly reduced rain to keep visibility good, no added actors, relying on existing signalized intersection to again produce an oracle-only red-light violation with ambiguous labels.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Keep the ego on essentially the same path through the same signalized environment, modifying only spawn/destination slightly to perturb timing while preserving conditions where the external oracle can flag a red-light violation with traffic-light data present but without clearly establishing route–light or stop-line relations. No collisions or deliberate lane crossings are introduced so that any stuck or lane_invasion labels, if present, remain ambiguous and potentially conflicting with the oracle.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure Town01 map is loaded and original signalized intersection topology on the mission route remains unchanged.
Verify at least one traffic light is active and publishing on /carla/traffic_lights along or near the ego route.
Confirm that no additional non-ego actors or explicit lane-boundary perturbations are injected beyond this spec.
post_execution_validation_rules: Check error.json reports a red-light violation and no collision.
Verify /carla/traffic_lights messages are present during the critical window.
Confirm that available summaries cannot conclusively determine route–light relation or exact stop-line crossing at the violation time (keep them unknown or unlogged).
Check that no explicit lane-boundary crossing evidence is logged; if lane invasion is labeled, it must not be directly supported by a lane-crossing summary.
Inspect dataset-level labels for possible stuck or lane_invasion annotations and verify that any such labels remain in conflict or not fully aligned with the oracle events.
uncertainty: The exact reason the oracle flags a red-light violation may still not be provable from summaries due to missing route–light relation and stop-line crossing evidence.
Any dataset-level stuck or lane_invasion labels may again appear without direct supporting evidence, preserving label–oracle conflict.
Controller and actuation behavior (e.g., vehicle_cmd vs vehicle_status) may remain ambiguous without deeper internal logs.
